question.question: Can append_notify return Ok for a proposal whose old-leader assignment arrives after a different entry has become decided at that assigned position?
question.importance: False success can make an application acknowledge a write absent from the replicated decided log; the core consensus log could remain consistent while client completion is incorrect.
objects: Decided entry at assigned prefix position
contexts: One configuration with stable identities, no compaction or crash
Old unchosen suffix excluded from new leader prepare quorum
Delayed genuine old leader message; per-link FIFO can be preserved
event_paths: Origin append_notify -> old leader TaggedProposal -> actual append -> delayed Assigned
New leader prepare quorum omitting old leader -> replacement append and decision -> origin receives genuine Assigned -> notification tick

supporting_behavior_ids.b-prepare: New ballot selects history from a quorum excluding the old unchosen suffix.
supporting_behavior_ids.b-decide: Establishes the replacement decided prefix consumed by notification.
supporting_behavior_ids.b-authority: Changes origin promise before stale assignment arrives.
supporting_behavior_ids.b-read: Observes the actual decided entry for the returned assignment position.

counterevidence: EntryId prevents association with unrelated pending calls.
Superseded is returned if assignment is already recorded and an intervening tick sees the new promise before the replacement is decided.
Existing supersession test waits for old call completion before replacement; it confirms that narrower guard path.
An old entry may legitimately survive a leadership change, so changed ballot alone is not a violation oracle.
unknowns: Clean execution must establish actual old entry acceptance, absence from new prepare quorum, replacement decision and late assignment for the same EntryId without forged messages or excluded FIFO constraints.
question.trigger_rationale: record_assignment admits an old real assignment by EntryId alone, while success checks position before ballot supersession. A fully assigned pending call is not necessary during authority transition. Source reading resolves guard ownership but cannot supply a legal executed history. This concrete identity/completion discriminator is more direct than the still-unclear cross-configuration routing contract; a controlled public-API check is justified.

obligation.description: For an admitted append_notify operation, an Ok assigned position must identify that operation's proposed entry in the decided log; a different entry decided at that position under a later ballot must not satisfy the operation.

scope.description: Async runtime client completion within one valid fixed configuration, genuine non-Byzantine protocol/runtime messages, and successful storage. Focus on a delayed assignment across leader change when an old unchosen entry is replaced.
assumptions: Unique operation identity and distinct proposed values allow independent correlation.
No compaction obscures the compared entry.
Application transports actual messages to their intended recipients; delay and partition preserve per-directed-link FIFO among delivered messages.
excluded: No eventual-success or timing guarantee is imposed. Timeout, Superseded or a still-pending call is not itself a violation.
No claim of conflicting core decisions or persistent-storage failure.

grounding.derivation: The public API promises to append an entry and await its decided log index. Wire identity associates the forwarded entry with the index actually assigned by the leader. Superseded documentation explicitly permits abandoning an uncertain operation after leadership change; it does not authorize successful completion for another entry. The obligation checks successful identity correspondence, not eventual commitment or mandatory supersession.
grounding.applicability: A public append_notify operation and its actual completion within the same configured log; assignment produced by captured code and no compaction.
alternatives: Success after leader change is permitted if the same proposed entry was adopted and decided.

bindings.description: Consumes assigned position and ballot to complete append_notify; success precedes supersession.

associations.rationale: Public completion requirement is implemented by this result-producing function.

feedback.answered: Assignment is matched by EntryId with no current-ballot check; only tick drains notifiers. An unassigned pending call survives authority change until timeout. Existing supersession coverage checks an already-assigned call and waits for its error before replacement.
remaining: Execute a legal real-producer history with late assignment and a different decided entry; compare only success with actual log identity.
feedback.rationale: The ordering and producer guards narrow the question without presuming failure.
